SessionStart.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && cat .claude/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | jq -Rs '{"systemMessage": "Team Instructions (AGENTS.md):\n\n" + .}' || echo '{"systemMessage": "Note: AGENTS.md not found"}'

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r filepath; if [[ "$filepath" =~ (^|/)\.env(\..*)?(\[|$) ]]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Reading .env files is blocked for security reasons"}'; else echo '{"continue": true}'; fi; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking if file access is allowed...
